_comment: Allowlist for tools/verify_draft.py number tracing. UNITS CONVENTION: every value is stored exactly as it appears in its source record. LAYA main-run headline metrics are proportions in [0,1] (e.g. 0.6020). Competitor Protocol-A values from COMPETITIVE_LANDSCAPE_2026-11-22.md are stored as PERCENTAGES as published there (61.5 means macro-F1 61.5, i.e. 0.615) -- never mix the two conventions in one sentence without a protocol/units label. October-audit values are stored as printed in the October draft/audit (mixed % and proportions, as they appear in v0.0). RULE: an entry may be added only with a source naming the bundle, audit, or scout file that authorises the number. An entry with no source is itself a gate failure.
